checksums.name: sma4_block_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: stored_u16_le = (sum of all 4096 block bytes with bytes at stored_offset..stored_offset+1 taken as 0) mod 65536; byte-sum accumulated in 16-bit short by FUN_0803c0b8; includes magic; no seed/complement

checksums.name: m3p0_block_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_0803c0b8 byte-sum mod 65536 over full 0x1000 block (both duplicated 0x800 halves) with field at +0x04 zeroed; second half field at +0x804 left 0x0000

checksums.name: s4cp_block_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_0803c0b8 byte-sum mod 65536 over full 0x1000 block with field at +0x04 zeroed; empty payload gives 0x011a = sum of magic bytes 0x53+0x34+0x43+0x50

io_driver_functions.notes: Flash bank switch: 0xAA/0x55 unlock, 0xB0 command, bank byte to 0x0E000000; only for 0x20000-size device
Read Flash ID: 0x90 autoselect, two ID bytes via 0x080eb35c, 0xF0 reset; returns (id1<<8)|id2
Identify device: walks ROM device-info table (ID at +0x28), copies matched entry to current-device globals
Select device type index (called with 2); presets info pointer
Copy Flash polling routine from ROM to RAM/stack buffer (Thumb pointer buffer+1)
Flash read transfer Flash->RAM: bank-switch if 1M, then 0x080eb354(flash_addr, ram, len, stack_code)
Flash program transfer RAM->Flash: bank-switch if 1M, then 0x080eb354(ram, flash_addr, len, stack_code); direction inferred from argument order
Sector write with verify: up to 3x (0x080eb350 erase/status then FUN_080eaed4 program)
Sector erase 0x80/0x30 to sector base + poll via 0x080eb354 mode 2; no caller in corpus (erase folded into 0x080eb350 step or jumptable)
Single-byte program 0xA0 then *dst=*src in Flash window; no caller in corpus
Byte-sum mod 65536 over param_1 (always 0x1000) bytes from staging buffer base _DAT_0803c0e0
Write one 0x1000 staging buffer to Flash sector, retry x3, FUN_0803af0c(err) on failure; quiesce via 0x080e8444/restore 0x080e8490
Read-then-program wrapper retry x3 (FUN_080ead70 read + FUN_080eaed4 program); no caller in callgraph (jumptable/pointer entry not traced)
SMA4 payload serializer: field copies incl 72 records x0x15 (src stride 0x16)
M3P0 builder: 0x31C intermediate expanded twice via FUN_0803c6b0(0)/(0x800) into duplicated halves
Expand intermediate into staging buffer at offset param (0 or 0x800), 8 groups, OR-combined bytes
Group-A-only sub-object builder (8 entries x 9B x4 sources + mirrored bytes, tail 0x1F/0x40)
